title: 第3章 敌袭！
slug: 史上第一祖师爷全本免费-史上第一祖师爷最新章节列表
content_zh:
那是一块悬崖上凸起的岩石，灰黑色的岩石中有紫色的光芒透出来，仿佛人的呼吸一样，有节奏的一闪一闪。
紫光每次闪动，就发出一阵雷鸣声，“轰隆隆”低沉作响。
林锋扫视四周，没发现别人的埋伏。
运气不错，看来自己是第一个赶到的。
林锋迅速攀上悬崖，一只手如同钩子一样抓牢岩石，另外一只手也不用法术，就是运起法力一拳轰在凸起的岩石上。
岩石与悬崖脱离，掉落在悬崖底下，林锋下了悬崖找到岩石，虽然同悬崖脱离，但岩石仍然有生命似的闪动着紫光，发出阵阵雷鸣声。
林锋拍碎了岩石，露出藏在里面的宝物，是一块有地球上足球大小的紫色晶石，从中传出雷霆轰鸣声。
紫色晶石表面凹凸不平，坑坑洼洼，并不规则。
摸索了片刻，林锋发现这块紫色晶石仍然是不是宝物的本体，倒有些像是玉石外面包裹了一层石皮。
林锋缓缓将自己的法力注入紫色晶石中，试图同晶石内部的宝物联系。
轰轰轰轰轰轰轰轰！！
林锋只感觉自己进入一个雷的世界，放眼过去，全是闪烁爆裂的雷霆闪电。
一种无边无际的大恐惧，大威压。
狂暴的雷霆，远古的神罚，凶猛的闪电，洪荒的天谴，震动着每一个面对它的人的天魂不停的颤抖，却还要自动扑上去，然后被打得魂飞魄散。
一种泰山压卵的威势，真正的泰山压卵，大山压下，顷刻之间碎成齑粉！
林锋一惊，九霄天雷正法的道法自动运转起来，不是抵抗，不是同化，而是驾驭。
我为万雷之主，执掌诸天雷霆。
仿佛只是一瞬，又仿佛过了许久，林锋神智重新清醒，再看手中的紫色晶石已经从中间裂成两半，露出中心处一枚淡金色的浑圆宝珠。
雷鸣声和闪动的雷光都已经消失不见，只剩下拳头大小的宝珠闪动着淡金色的光辉，看上去无比平静，但林锋却可以感觉到珠子内蕴含着无比恐怖的雷系灵气。
这些雷系灵气如果全部引爆开来，足以把林锋此刻身处的连绵山脉炸成凹陷的盆地。

兑换系统中有一模一样的东西，名为天雷玉魄，要足足两千兑换点。
按照系统说明，这东西极为稀有，需要数以千计的天雷，连续击打在同一块岩石上，才有百分之一概率诞生，蕴含了海量的雷系灵气精华，对修练雷系道法的修真者来说是无价之宝。
林锋笑得眼睛都眯成一条缝，很无耻的想道：“乖徒弟，这就当是你的拜师礼了，放心吧，为师不会亏待你的。”
隐约听到山脚下的丛林里传来声音，林锋快速收好天雷玉魄，向下望去，就见山的两侧，各有一伙人马正飞速向这里赶来。
其中一拨人，打头的正是小不点，看着跟个瓷娃娃一样粉白可爱，但此时却灵活的如同一头小山兽，在深山老林里飞速前行。
之前小不点一直没有显露，现在林锋才发现，这个不到四岁大的孩子，竟然也有练气二层的修为。
林锋习惯性的摸摸鼻子，感觉压力山大：“那老村长是疯子吧？教这么小的孩子修练道法。”
另外一拨人，则是狼村的人。
林锋计算了一下双方速度，确定是小不点和石村人先一步赶到，便把取出天雷玉魄后剩余的石皮，也就是那裂成两半的紫色晶石留在原地，然后自己飞快离开现场。
虽然天雷玉魄已经被取出，但那裂成两半的紫色晶石被玉魄温养了这么久，也蕴含了海量的灵气，是不可多得的宝物。
天上阴云密布，雷声阵阵，林锋抬头望天，喃喃自语：“风雨欲来啊……”
一如林锋所料，小不点等人先一步捡到了石皮，虽然惋惜石皮中真正的宝物已经被人捷足先登，但总算没有空手而回，一群人兴高采烈的回村。
狼村人就郁闷了，肉没吃到，连汤都没捞着，他们自然不知道真正的宝物天雷玉魄落入林锋之手，只当是被石村抢了先手。
新仇旧恨加在一块，狼村人顿时炸了锅，红着眼睛向小不点等人追去。
林锋便在这时很“巧合”的碰上了狼村人。狼风的爷爷狼里青，黑着脸看了林锋一眼：“你在这里干什么？”
林锋一脸的不好意思：“想进山里长长见识，谁知道却迷路了。”

content_en:
It was a protruding rock on the cliff. Purple light shone through the gray-black rock, flickering rhythmically like human breathing.
Every time the purple light flashed, there was a burst of thunder and a low "rumbling" sound.
Lin Feng glanced around and found no one else ambush.
As luck would have it, it seemed that he was the first to arrive.
Lin Feng quickly climbed up the cliff, grabbing the rock with one hand like a hook. The other hand did not use magic, but used magic power to punch the protruding rock.
The rock broke away from the cliff and fell to the bottom of the cliff. Lin Feng went down the cliff and found the rock. Although it was separated from the cliff, the rock still flashed purple light and made bursts of thunder as if it were alive.
Lin Feng smashed the rock, revealing the treasure hidden inside. It was a purple crystal stone the size of a football on Earth, and thunder roared from it.
The surface of the purple spar is uneven, pitted and irregular.
After groping for a moment, Lin Feng discovered that the purple spar was still not the actual treasure, but more like a layer of stone skin wrapped around the jade.
Lin Feng slowly injected his mana into the purple crystal, trying to contact the treasure inside the crystal.
Boom boom boom boom boom boom! !
Lin Feng only felt that he had entered a world of thunder. Looking over, there were all flashing and exploding thunder and lightning.
A kind of boundless fear and pressure.
The violent thunder, ancient divine punishment, ferocious lightning, and prehistoric scourge shook the soul of everyone who faced it to tremble, but they still pounced on it automatically, and were beaten to death.
A kind of power of Mount Tai squeezing the egg, the real Mount Tai squeezing the egg, the mountain crushes it into powder in an instant!
Lin Feng was startled. The method of Jiuxiao Tianlei Zhengfa started to operate automatically. It was not resistance, not assimilation, but control.
I am the Lord of Ten Thousand Thunders, in charge of the thunder in the heavens.
It seemed like just a moment, and it seemed like a long time passed, Lin Feng regained consciousness, and looked at the purple crystal in his hand that had been split in half from the middle, revealing a pale golden round orb in the center.
The thunder and the flashing thunder light had disappeared, leaving only the fist-sized orb flashing with pale golden light. It looked extremely calm, but Lin Feng could feel that the extremely terrifying thunder aura contained in the bead.
If all these thunder spiritual energy were detonated, it would be enough to blow up the continuous mountains where Lin Feng was now into a sunken basin.
There is an identical thing in the exchange system, called Tianlei Jade Soul, which costs a full two thousand exchange points.
According to the system description, this thing is extremely rare. It requires thousands of sky thunders to continuously hit the same rock to have a one percent chance of being born. It contains a large amount of thunder spiritual energy essence and is a priceless treasure for cultivators who practice thunder Taoism.
Lin Feng smiled so hard that his eyes narrowed, and he thought shamelessly: "Good disciple, this is your apprenticeship ceremony. Don't worry, my master will not treat you badly."
Hearing vague sounds coming from the jungle at the foot of the mountain, Lin Feng quickly put away the Heavenly Thunder Jade Soul and looked down. He saw a group of people on both sides of the mountain rushing towards here at a high speed.
Among the group of people, the leader was the little one, who looked as pink and cute as a porcelain doll, but at this time, he was as nimble as a small mountain beast, moving quickly in the deep mountains and old forests.
The little one had not been revealed before, but now Lin Feng discovered that this child, who was less than four years old, actually had the second level of Qi training.
Lin Feng touched his nose habitually, feeling a lot of pressure: "Then the old village chief is a lunatic, right? Teaching such a young child to practice Taoism."
The other group of people are from Wolf Village.
Lin Feng calculated the speed of both parties and determined that Xiao Bu Dian and the Shicun people arrived first. He left the remaining stone skin after taking out the Tianlei Jade Soul, that is, the purple spar that was split in two, and left the scene quickly.
Although the thunder jade spiritIt has been taken out, but the purple crystal that was split in half has been warmed by the jade soul for so long, and it also contains a huge amount of spiritual energy, making it a rare treasure.
The sky was covered with clouds and there were bursts of thunder. Lin Feng looked up at the sky and murmured to himself: "A storm is coming..."
Just as Lin Feng expected, Xiao Bu Dian and others picked up the stone skin first. Although it was a pity that the real treasure in the stone skin had been caught first, they finally did not return empty-handed. A group of people returned to the village happily.
The people of Lang Village were depressed. They didn't eat the meat, and they didn't even get the soup. Naturally, they didn't know that the real treasure, Tianlei Jade Soul, had fallen into Lin Feng's hands. They just thought that Shi Cun had taken the lead.
New and old grudges were added together, and the people of Wolf Village suddenly went crazy, chasing after Xiao Budian and others with red eyes.
Lin Feng met a man from Wolf Village by "coincidence" at this time. Lang Feng's grandfather, Lang Liqing, glanced at Lin Feng with a dark face: "What are you doing here?"
Lin Feng looked embarrassed: "I wanted to go into the mountains to see more, but who knew I got lost."
